_comment: Lane A = mechanical auto-apply, provable WITHOUT external facts. Starts deliberately narrow; grows only by owner-approved rules. Every rule carries `why`, which is recorded as the change's reasoning.
_relevance_note: Owner policy 2026-08-13: dated events that passed more than this many days ago are IGNOREd (history, not staleness). Events from the window onward, and future ones, are processed; those within [now-window, now+90d] are priority=high and planned first.

autonomy._comment: The autonomy dial. HIGH-confidence changes in auto_locations may auto-apply; HIGH in other locations is capped to MEDIUM (queues); never_locations always queue and are never edited. Promote a location here after its precision is proven over review batches. No code changes needed.

_date_bump_field_note: Set to the Webflow field slug of the visible 'last updated' date once confirmed (policy: bump on Lane B factual changes only). Empty = no bumping.

lane_a_rules.why: Session range explicitly framed as the CURRENT session; rolling it forward is calendar arithmetic, not a factual assertion.
